text:
Optimizations to mention

Speed: SSR/stream, code split, lazy
  images, preload LCP, virtualize lists
Network: cache, dedupe, debounce,
  abort stale, prefetch on intent
A11y: semantic HTML, focus, keyboard,
  live regions, reduced motion
Security: escape output, CSP,
  HttpOnly cookies, CSRF
i18n: Intl dates/numbers, RTL
Observe: RUM vitals + errors
